prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of heavy timber walls seen from above: dark squared wooden beams laid side by side, iron brackets. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square, seamless tileable TOP-DOWN JRPG ground texture showing ONLY the upper surface of heavy timber walls: closely packed dark squared wooden beams laid side by side, with occasional restrained dark iron brackets embedded across adjoining beams. Orthographic straight-down/steep classic RPG map view, no perspective convergence. Fill the full square edge to edge with wood surface. Left/right edges must join continuously and top/bottom edges must join continuously, including beam lines, grain and color. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand placed pixels: uniform crisp large square pixels throughout (each art pixel approximately 7–8 display pixels), hard pixel edges, bold readable clusters of 3–10 pixels. Rich earthy worn dark walnut and umber wooden beams, muted purple-red saturated crevice shadows, warm ochre yellow highlights, 4–6 discrete shades per material. Weathered angular wood grain, square beam seams, occasional angular dark iron straps and rivets distributed evenly, not a focal point. Even neutral soft upper-left ambient lighting, clean base colors. No cast shadows, no nighttime, no glow, no vignette, no scene, no border, no frame, no objects, no text. STRICT no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic texture, noise, checkerboard dithering. Maintain consistent pixel grid and seamless repeating composition.
